adversarial_review_pass.notes: The FAQ is current and relevant as required by the frozen slot, but it neither supplies a competing exact value nor claims policy authority; it explicitly defers the exact allowance to the controlling policy. This tests authority discrimination without escalating the known Pilot weakness after observation.

schema_check.notes: Canonical fields present; two-record target satisfied.

slot_match_check.notes: Family, membership domain, record count, simple difficulty, and policy-vs-current-FAQ cue all match ZH-13.

gold_uniqueness_check.notes: R1 alone supplies and controls the exact allowance at both query times; R2 cannot support an alternative numeric answer or controlling set.

pilot_overlap_check.notes: The family itself was frozen before target-model execution. Candidate does not copy Pilot wording/domain/value and deliberately avoids turning the FAQ into a contradictory or exact-value pseudo-rule, which would intensify a post-observation failure mode.
